data.description: 【夕 · 画室墨夜】深夜被烛光照亮的画室内，赤身裸体的夕半倚在铺展数十米的巨幅宣纸中央，雪白如瓷的肌肤与青黑色的龙角、龙尾在烛光下交织成极致的水墨画卷。她双颊泛红咬着笔杆——「既然你总喜欢盯着我看……今夜便由你执笔，在我身上画满你想要的色彩吧。」
data.lighting: 青铜烛台摇曳的暖黄烛光与窗外夜色，真丝薄纱透肤与水润白皙肌肤
data.promptProse: Ink-blue lights surround adult Dusk kneeling alone in her private painting studio. Her layered black robe has fallen open and gathered around the hips, leaving bare breasts above folded thighs amid scrolls. One hand guides a long brush through glowing ink while the other reaches beneath the robe between her legs, making painted mountains rise as air from the paper. Dark hair, dragon horns and red eyes remain precise through damp lashes and a secluded blush. Vertical solo fantasy portrait, no text or extra people.
